Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this clash. But we have two more warm-up matches lined up. India will face England and Australia will take on New Zealand. Both the games will start at 6 pm Local (2 pm GMT). Switch tabs and enjoy that action!

The Windies bowlers did not have enough runs to defend but they still won't be happy with their bowling. Pakistan chased this down with ease and Kieron Pollard would have loved their bowlers to make it difficult for them. There were a few positives though like Ravi Rampaul who bowled quite economically. Hayden Walsh too did go for runs but he is in the side to take wickets and he did get two. Overall though, it was an under-par performance from the defending champions.

Pakistan did lose Mohammad Rizwan in the Powerplay but it was once again their main man, Babar Azam, who rose to the occasion. He along with Fakhar Zaman, who was initially not in the 15, put up a really good stand to take their side to the brink of victory. Babar Azam and Mohammad Hafeez then fell in quick succession but Shoaib Malik and Zaman ensured that there were no more wickets to fall and finished the job in style.

Quite an easy win for Pakistan in the end and their preparation for the World Cup has begun in a pretty good manner. Their bowlers were on the mark to keep Windies down to a low score and the batters chased it down easily.
SIX! What a shot to seal the match! Tossed up, around off. Zaman clears his front leg and smokes it over long on for a maximum! Pakistan WIN THE MATCH BY 7 WICKETS!
Flatter ball, on middle. Shoaib Malik eases it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up, outside off. Shoaib Malik reaches out, takes it on the full and sweeps it wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Short ball, well outside off. Fakhar Zaman misses his pull. 11 runs needed from 30 balls.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Shoaib Malik whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball, around off. Shoaib Malik drives hard but finds the mid off fielder.
Length ball, outside off. Shoaib Malik lofts it over covers and takes a couple.
Back of a length, around off. Shoaib Malik looks to guide it past short third man but gets an inside edge on the bounce, to the keeper.
DROPPED! Length ball, around off. Fakhar Zaman looks to slog hard but it goes off the toe end of the bat towards Hayden Walsh at deep square leg who drops it. A single taken!
Malik runs down the track so Walsh bowls it way outside off. Malik does well to get bat on it.
FOUR! Hit hard! Tossed up, on off. Malik sweeps it over short mid-wicket for a boundary.
A single as this is pushed to long off.
FOUR! Flatter ball, on off. Zaman plays the reverse sweep and gets it from the toe end. The ball goes through the keeper's legs for a boundary.
SIX! Clobbered! Tossed up, on off. Zaman gets under it and pumps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Just a single as this is pushed to long on.
Short of a length, on off. Zaman plays it past mid-wicket for a couple.
Short of a length, outside off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Short ball, on leg. Malik works it to fine leg for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to mid off.
Short of a length, outside off. Zaman cuts it past point for a single.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.
Shoaib Malik is the new man in. Also, Obed McCoy comes back to bowl.
OUT! TAKEN! A golden duck for Hafeez! Tossed up, outside off. He slog-sweeps but straight to the man at short mid-wicket. Shimron Hetmyer takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shimron Hetmyer b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Hafeez walks out to bat.
OUT! STUMPED! Good piece of bowling! Walsh sees Azam come down the track and shortens his length. Azam looks to block but the ball goes past the outside edge and Pooran does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: st Nicholas Pooran b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Just a single as this is played to long off.
Fifty for Azam and he has led from the front. These are good signs for Pakistan and they become a dangerous side when Azam scores. Tossed up, on off. Pushed to long off for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up, outside off. Zaman drives it to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Length ball, on off. Azam backs away to the leg side and drives it over covers for a boundary.
Length ball, down the leg side. Azam misses the flick. Wide called.
Length ball, around off. Pushed to third man for one.
FOUR! Again! Short of a length, outside off. Zaman goes for the cut but gets the outside edge. The ball runs to the third man fence.
FOUR! Top shot! Full ball, on off. Zaman drives it nicely down the ground. The man from mid off dives to his left but gets no hands on it. Boundary.
Back of a length, around leg. Azam clips it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, on the pads. Zaman gets hit on the pads and it rolls away. A leg bye is taken.

Drinks break! Pakistan are in a really strong position here and it would take a collapse from here for them to lose this game. This has been a good show by them so far and they would want to finish things off quickly.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Babar Azam turns it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Babar clips it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, outside off. Babar Azam defends it off the front foot.
Quicker ball, around off. Babar Azam punches it hard back to the bowler.

FOUR! DROPPED! Tossed up, around off. Babar Azam skips down and miscues his heave in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Shimron Hetmyer there runs to his left and drops it. The ball goes over the ropes and Babar Azam collects another boundary.
FOUR! BANG! A half-tracker, outside off. Babar Azam rocks back and pulls it hard to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
In the air, but safe! Short ball, outside off. Babar Azam miscues his pull towards the long on fielder, on the bounce. The batters cross for a single.
Length ball, just outside off. Babar Azam defends it awkwardly off the front foot.
Good-length ball, on middle. Babar Azam blocks it off the back foot.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off. Babar Azam looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of the blade and beats the deep cover fielder to go into the fence.
Short of a length, around off. Fakhar Zaman works it to mid off and takes a quick run.
Good-length ball, around off. Babar Azam looks to drive on the up but it goes off the inside edge towards square leg. A single taken.
Just a tad short, outside off. Fakhar Zaman punches it to cover. The fielder there fumbles and concedes an extra run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Babar Azam taps it to backward point and takes a single.
A short ball, outside off. Babar Azam cuts it to wide of deep cover for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, on middle. Babar Azam shimmies down and works it to mid-wicket.
Floated, outside off. Babar Azam looks to flick but it takes the leading edge past Chris Gayle at covers for a couple.
Nicely tossed up, around middle. Babar Azam skips down to slog but he misses and gets hit on the pads.
Roston Chase comes back on. He went for 10 in his first over.
Shorter ball, outside off. Babar Azam cuts it towards deep point and takes a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Fakhar Zaman eases it to long off for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Babar Azam pulls it to long on for a single.
FOUR! SHOT! A half-tracker, outside off. Babar Azam hangs back and cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
Wide! Tossed up, outside off, turning away late. Babar Azam leaves it. Wided!
A googly, shorter in length, around off. Fakhar Zaman stays back and taps it to point for a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Fakhar Zaman clips it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Change. Hayden Walsh comes on.
A single to end the Powerplay as this is pushed to mid off. Pakistan are 42 for 1 at the end of 6 overs.
FOUR! Clobbered! On a length, on off. Zaman dances down the track and heaves it over mid on for a boundary.
Length ball, on the pads. Flicked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, down the leg side. Zaman misses the flick. Wide called.
Fakhar Zaman is the new man in.
OUT! BOWLED! Pakistan lose their first one! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Rizwan looks to drive but gets the inside edge back onto the stumps.
Full ball, on off. Rizwan chips it aerially to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Short of a length, around off. Azam goes for the pull but gets the inside edge to short fine leg for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Punched to covers by Rizwan.
A full ball, outside off. Rizwan swipes it wide of deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Short of a length, outside off. Azam punches it to deep cover for one.
A slower full toss, on leg. Rizwan chips it past square leg for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Rizwan looks to pull but gets hit on the helmet. No ball called as Obed McCoy has overstepped. Free Hit coming up.
Full ball, around leg. Azam looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The batters cross over and take a leg bye.
On a length, outside off. Played to third man for one.
SIX! BANG! What a shot! Loopy ball, on off. Babar Azam shimmies down and sends it sailing over long on for a maximum!
Tossed up, outside off. Babar Azam gets down on his knee to sweep but he misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Flatter ball, around off. Babar Azam cuts hard but finds Lendl Simmons at covers.
Flatter ball, on off. Azam cuts it to covers but the fielder dives and stops the ball.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed to point. Rizwan wants a single but is sent back.
Roston Chase comes into the attack.
FOUR! Smacked! Shorter ball, outside off. Babar Azam slaps it through cover for a boundary.
Good running again. This is fuller and on off. Azam taps it towards backward point and sets off for a single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Back of a length, on off. Punched to mid off.
On a length, on off. Rizwan swipes it to deep square leg for one.
Excellent running. On a length, on leg. Rizwan flicks it away towards deep square leg. The fielder comes running in but fails to collect it cleanly. The batters take the second.
Length ball, on off. Azam taps it to mid on for one.
Length ball, on off. Rizwan works it past mid-wicket for one.
On a length, outside off. Pushed past point for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Punched past covers for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Azam cuts it hard. The man at deep cover gets across and dives to stop the ball.
This one is short of a length, outside off. Rizwan hits it to deep point for one.
On a length, around off. Rizwan pushes it to cover.
Length ball, outside off. Punched to covers.
Obed McCoy starts with a length ball, wide outside off. Left alone and called a wide.
Length ball, on the pads. Worked to mid-wicket.
Who will bowl from the other end? Obed McCoy it is!
Length ball, down the leg side. Azam misses the flick and it is called a wide.
Nicely played. On a length, outside off. Azam drives it past covers for a couple.
Length ball, around off. Azam blocks it from the crease.
Pakistan are underway! Length ball, on off. Mohammad Rizwan pushes it to mid on for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Rizwan chops it back towards the keeper.
Fuller ball, on off. Rizwan pushes it to mid off.
